description.text: NO PREVIOUS RECORDS. This has been categorized as an Aggelos due to the nature of its formation. Its outward appearance mimics that of Nefarith. Despite its high core energy readings, the entity seems to be rather unstable.
The awakened Marble Aggelomoirai can summon countless Ankhors from the universe to bombard the land. Dodge these attacks to find a way to retaliate.
